signal: comp_rank_ew6 (Phase 3 definition, spec hashes in phase3_specs.json), horizon 5
composite: per signal date, mean over the six direction-adjusted cross-sectional pct ranks on universe rows; >=4 of 6 present
universe: factor_factory/config/universe_rules.yaml via build_universe rules over the exact-date PIT snapshot; STAR/BSE excluded; ST by PIT is_st and name patterns
market_proxy_for_ivol: EW mean c2c over SH/SZ main + ChiNext codes with a daily row

books.avoid_losers_70: universe excluding the bottom 30% by composite (NaN composite kept), equal weight
books.buffered_top100: K=100, enter top 15%, keep while inside top 35%, industry cap 15 names, equal weight
books.benchmark_ew: whole universe, equal weight (investable EW benchmark)

cadence: rebalance on every 5th official session counting from the anchor (first official signal date)
execution: D4 rules: trade at the T+1 open; limit-up open blocks buys; limit-down open or suspension blocks sells (held until sellable); delisted names written off at the last traded close; drift between rebalances
forward_only: a signal is official only if recorded before 09:30 Asia/Shanghai on its entry session; missed signal dates are logged as gaps, never backfilled
regime_tag: per settled period: 'up' if the benchmark period return > 0, else 'down'

evaluation.when: after 50 matured periods per book; no promotion decision before that
evaluation.primary: mean period net excess vs benchmark_ew, Newey-West t (lag 1), per book; the first period (initial build-up trade) is excluded, as in gauntlet v2
evaluation.success: t >= 2.0 on at least one book

no_production_effect: never writes #/today, v4.3 artifacts, stock-report or production health files
